My dear [Mary](/person/1626)
You will like to know that the funeral is to be on Monday- her 48th birthday.

By her own wish, [she](/person/1462) is to be carried into Church at 8 for the Celebration.

Burial at 3.

Hymns ‘The King of Love’ and ‘Peace, perfect peace’ her own choice.
[Frances](/person/1604) is here I wish you could pay me a real visit a little later when the house has been set to rights, but I think I shall have to go out while it is doing- only for a few days.

But I would make all fit to what you could give me of time, and there will be plenty of room now.
I can’t feel yet what the difference will be
your loving

C M Yonge
